concept: 1978 VHS ritual in the language of The Holy Mountain: in a bone-white chapel, a bald alchemist in a white robe kneels with his back to the camera before a golden altar where two blobs of raw flesh slowly melt into each other and tear apart, a thread of blood falling from the ceiling lamp; a 117 in dripping blood on the bare wall
audio_source: original sound made locally: synthesized organ, bells and noise with Windows text-to-speech voices; no third-party audio
